newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan spokesman confident yen won't fall further.
newsitem.headline: Japan spokesman confident yen won't fall further.

text.p: Japan's chief government spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference on Friday that he was confident the yen would not fall below the 120 yen level against the dollar.
"For industry, the weaker yen has its merits and its demerits, but instability in the (foreign exchange) markets is undesirable," Kajiyama told a news conference.
"I feel as if the yen has dropped to its lowest limit," he said, adding that this view was his own personal conjecture.
"I am confident that Japan's economic situation is such that the yen will not fall below the 120 yen level."
There were also arguments that recent fluctuations in currency markets were due to the dollar's strength rather than the yen's weakness, he said.
